dct_title_s: Map of Nicollet Island, scale 1" = 50 ft., showing sewer tunnels and drainage, from surveys made in Dec. 1894
dct_alternative_sm: Map of Nicollet Island, scale 1" = 50 ft., showing sewer tunnels and drainage, from surveys made in Dec. 1894
dct_description_sm: Oriented with north toward the upper left.; Sewer tunnels on the map are numbered and described.; Shows buildings and lot boundaries.; Includes a legend explaining the markings that describe building materials of houses and whether or not they are connected to the sewer.; Includes numbered cross-sectional diagrams of the tunnels along with descriptions of the materials of their construction.; "P-1-32."
